messages.text: Hi my coupon Thanks-10 is not working, can you help?
Looked something up in Shopify

That code was a Thanksgiving Sale, 10% off, and it ran out on October 13, so it won't apply any more. Sorry about that.

The Magic Miner 40T is $799 right now, 40 TH/s, Batch 8 shipping December 7, 2026, and it's the best value per TH we sell.

If you've got an order with us, give me the order number and I'll see what I can do on it.
Oh no. Can I get a coupon for a discount?
Ran goodwill.py (order-swap skill)
I can look at a credit for you, but it's tied to an order. What's your order number and the email on it?
(email hidden)
Used the order-swap skill

Done, I've made you a code: HD-••••••, $25 off your next order. It's yours alone and works on any order over $100.

On the Magic Miner 40T at $799 that brings it to $774. Want me to set the cart up for you?
Is that the best you can do? On your videos the guy shows it at a price of $746
Read the magic miner 40t page
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T

$25 is my limit, and the code I just gave you is yours to keep. The live price today is $799 for Batch 8, so with HD-•••••• it's $774.

If the video showed $746, that was a promo that's since ended. I can't bring an ended price back.

Want me to build the cart at $774 so you can check it out?
What you mean build the cart?

I put the Magic Miner 40T in a cart for you and hand you a checkout link, with the code already applied. You click it, fill in your address and pay on our own checkout page. Nothing is charged until you do.

Want me to set it up?
Oh ok yea
Built a cart

Here you go, cart's ready with the code applied:

····

Magic (address hidden), Batch 8, $799 minus $25, so $774 plus shipping and any tax at checkout. It ships December 7, 2026.

Anything else before you go through?
Thank you. That’s it for now
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what's holding you back from ordering the 40T tonight?
Maybe hoping for a 10% discount for the holiday or thanksgiving

Fair enough. I can't promise a holiday sale, and I don't know if one's coming, so I'd rather not have you wait on something I can't confirm. Batch 8 is 50 units, and the code is yours whenever you use it.

One more thing, if you don't mind: what number would make it an easy yes for you?
Im on a budget right now, that’s my problem. I have bought 2 m2 pros from you before and they were so expensive

Understood, and thanks for buying from us twice.

If the 40T is a stretch right now, the Hammer Thor P2 is $379 at the moment, down from $449, 10 TH/s at about 166 W. Less hashrate per dollar than the 40T, but a much smaller cheque, and your $25 code works on it too, so $354.

Honestly though, if you can wait and save, the 40T is the better buy per terahash.
Yea I saw that, I was going to buy that one. But the 40T sounds better

It is better per dollar: 40 TH/s for $774 against 10 TH/s for $354. The catch is power, 650 W at the wall versus 166 W, so the 40T costs about four times as much to run each month.

On a tight budget that monthly cost matters as much as the sticker.

Want me to run the real numbers, sats per month and power cost, for where you'd plug it in? Just tell me the state.
illinois
Ran the power-cost calculator

Then I'd put it plainly: per terahash the 40T is the better buy, and it's the unit I'd pick of the two. The T. P2 is the cheaper way in if the $774 doesn't fit this month.

Your cart link stays live and the code is yours either way, so there's no rush tonight.
Thank you. Quick question, why they take so long to ship?

The 40T isn't sitting on a shelf, it's built in batches. Batch 8 is 50 units, made and then shipped out, which is why it carries a date, December 7, 2026, rather than shipping tomorrow.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

In-stock units like the Thor P2 go out of the warehouse within a few business days instead.
I see. I like the interface it looks solid

That's Harlo OS, the dashboard on our Harlo and Hammer units. Solo mining to your own node and address, pool settings, temps and fan control all in one place.

You can see the builds, release notes and guides at https://harlolabs.com before you buy, so you know exactly what you're getting.
Oh cool. Which solo pool would you say is the best?

I'd rather not name one off the top of my head. What I can say is Harlo OS lets you point the miner at your own node or at a solo pool of your choice, and the setup is the same either way.

Want me to get JD, our hardware guy, to give you his pick? He's offline now, picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and replies to your email.
Sounds good. Yea I appreciate it
Handed to the team · pool recommendation is JD's call, not in product facts

Done, JD has it. He's offline tonight, picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to (email hidden), so no need to wait around here.

Your cart link and the $25 code stay valid in the meantime. Anything else I can dig into for you?
I appreciate your time. Thank you

Happy to help. Everything's set on your side: the cart's waiting, the code is yours, and JD's pool answer comes to your inbox tomorrow.

Good luck with the decision, and enjoy the hashing when you pull the trigger.
